text:
irene: alerting — short window (12:22 UTC) where snapshotter jobs overlapped with janitor scrubs in us-west1-cohortB; observed NVMe avgqu-sz spike and ~25% GPU attach failures during 2-3m window. nodes briefly remounted some volumes read-only.

paul: ouch. which snapshotters? scheduled backups or ad-hoc? any kernel logs?

irene: scheduled cluster backups + a late-running customer snapshot. kernel shows repeated flush/fsync stalls and occasional nvme error: `nvme_core: error status: 0x2` before remount. sample iostat: ```Device: r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await %util
nvme0n1 1.0 380.0 8.0 10240.0 54.0 8.7 16.5 99.8```

jess: sounds like tinywrite amplification from snapshot + scrub leading to cmd queue saturation. scheduler backlog for janitor shows 429s then burst scheduling once rate-limit lifted. janitor-bot: "scrub scheduler: rate-limit hit cohort=cohortB"

mike: immediate mitigations? recommend: 1) pause non-critical snapshots in cohortB for 20m; 2) throttle janitor to concurrency=1 and add per-pool jitter; 3) cordon read-only-remounted hosts; 4) bump attach timeout to 90s to reduce fallback thrash.

paul: agree. also consider enabling ephemeral attach fallback to local-ssd-compatible nodes for a short window rather than failing to remote. cost tradeoff but may reduce job churn.

irene: executing now: ops command `snapshotter pause --cluster us-west1 --tag noncritical --duration 1200s` and `janitor set-concurrency --pool cohortB --concurrency 1 --splay 600s`. ops-bot: "commands accepted"

jess: add monitoring queries to watch: `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(gpu_attach_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))`, `avg(nvme_avg_queue_size{cohort="cohortB"})`, and `increase(janitor_jobs_rate_limited_total[5m])`.

irene: cordoned two hosts that remounted RO at 12:24 UTC and set attach timeout 30s->90s in the autoscaler canary. janitor-bot: "cordon host-usw1-22, host-usw1-24"

mike: early results: avgqu dropped from ~9->2 in 6m and attach failures back to <1% by 12:30 UTC. will keep snapshot pause for 20m and reintroduce snapshotter with a staggered window.

paul: follow-ups: 1) audit snapshot schedule alignment with janitor windows, 2) add scheduler hysteresis to avoid 429 pileups, 3) investigate NVMe firmware error patterns on remounted hosts. file tickets and tag infra-storage.

irene: filing tickets now. cost note: fallback/minor reroutes estimated +$420 for the 10m impact window, logging to incident-costs. will open postmortem if recurring. :white_check_mark:
